title: What we *stand behind.*
intro: Five commitments from our own policies: the people, places and principles every one of our journeys depends on.

items.title: Local families and hosts
items.text: We build trips around the families who welcome our guests, and give preference to local food, goods and services.

items.title: Nature and protected areas
items.text: We promote excursions that support local nature, follow the rules of protected areas, and favour lesser-known places over crowded ones.

items.title: Heritage and customs
items.text: We respect local customs and traditions, include museums and craft workshops, and rule out illegal souvenirs and artefacts.

items.title: Fair work
items.text: Written contracts and pay above the official average for our team. Every partner must pay at least a living wage or the national minimum wage.

items.title: Protecting children
items.text: Every partner must keep children safe from labour and sexual exploitation and follow the Child-Protection Code — or the partnership ends.
